text: Saw a picture of my long-distance relationship girlfriend being carried by a male friend. I feel uncomfortable now. Thoughts? My girlfriend was at a house party last night and there were about six people, with one of them being a guy. The guy is a college friend and he's practically living at her flat. She rents the flat with one of her other female friends, and I know for a fact that guy is flirting with her friend. But last night I saw a picture that he posted where he was carrying her in his arms. It made me feel uneasy. I'm mostly okay with everything she does, but for some reason that picture made me feel very uncomfortable. I want to talk to her about this, but I might come across as being too insecure and jealous to feel this way. Would love some thoughts and advice on how to proceed. Thank you. Okay, let's break this down. First, long-distance relationships. Look, LDRs are one of the hardest things to pull off, and to even have a chance you need to be absolutely sure about your partner. In my opinion, they only work if it's temporary. Like, you've got a project for a few months or studies, and there's a clear date when you're back together. Otherwise, you're playing a Russian roulette. Chances of it working out long-term are very slim. Now, second, the girl. Stop thinking that calling out inappropriate behavior makes you insecure or jealous. No, your girlfriend is going to parties with other dudes while you are away, and now you find out she's literally being carried in the arms of another man. Not because she told you, but because he posted it. Let's be real here, there's a very high chance something more is going on. Most probably, she's cheating on you, if not physically, then emotionally. And let's say, for the sake of an argument, that this really was the only thing and nothing else happened. That still means your girlfriend has very low emotional intelligence and zero empathy. Because good girlfriend would know, if my boyfriend saw this, it would hurt him, and she clearly doesn't care. So, best case, she lacks empathy and doesn't really respect you. Worst case, she's cheating. Either way, she's not the right girl for you. The right course of action is to break up and move on.
